hooks.name: Frozen boundary check
hooks.description: When anything under stage/ or interface/ or MANIFEST.sha256 is saved, created or deleted, run sha256sum -c MANIFEST.sha256 plus a check for files that are not in the manifest. Fails loudly: the stage and the protocol are frozen.
